title: Churn Risk Agent built in Joule Studio (editorial coverage)
problem: Detect at-risk customers and trigger a retention response for sales teams.
depth: Secondary editorial description; no architecture or outcome metrics
facts: A proprietary ML model scores churn risk and ranks accounts; separate recommendation, availability and promotion agents then create an SAP inquiry and draft a retention email.
The only human step described is reviewing and sending the drafted email.
The agent is listed on the SAP Store; coverage reports a second-place finish in a SAP event but no business results.
interpretations: Combining a classical ML scorer with LLM agents is a sound split of responsibilities; the editorial source does not show how the pieces were validated.
review_exercise: Using only this description, list what you would need to see before recommending it to a distribution client.
lessons: Predictive scoring plus agentic action is a reusable shape.
Upgrade to Tier B when a builder-authored technical source is found.
adaptation: Candidate for B2B retention scenarios; needs a primary source.
